title: A/P Detail: a CSV of 50,000 rows downloads, 50,001 is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Pick two as-of dates: date A, on which A/P Detail has exactly 50,000 open lines, and date B, on which it has exactly 50,001.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Set the as-of date to date A.
  2. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Set the as-of date to date B.
  4. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • 50,000 document rows.

Step 2:

  • The CSV downloads with the "Success" message.

Step 3:

  • 50,001 document rows.

Step 4:

  • "This report is too large to export. Choose an earlier as-of date, then try again.": exactly one message, nothing downloaded.
  • There is no offer to email the export or prepare it in the background (that comes in a later phase).

No test site has 50,000 open A/P lines (the QA organization has 13,540), so a manual tester cannot reach this limit; the developers check it in their own check task (SV-11598).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-N2: “Over 50,000 rows, the CSV is refused: no download, and the message "This report is too large to export. Choose an earlier as-of date, then try again." Exactly 50,000 rows is allowed.”
  • S3-N3: “A refused export shows exactly one message (S3-N1 or S3-N2), never a second generic error.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “CSV export over 50,000 rows | "This report is too large to export. Choose an earlier as-of date, then try again." | Error toast, as on the other reports; nothing downloads”
  • S3-R9: “The row count for the export limits is the number of customer or vendor rows (Summaries) or document rows (the other four), not counting headers, subtotals or the Totals row.”
  • Out of Scope: “Background exports for very large reports ("we'll email you when it's ready"), as Sage Intacct does. In this release, over the export limits the user is told to choose an earlier as-of date. Background exports come as a later phase of this epic (SV-11445): over the limit, the export is prepared in the background and the user gets an in-app notification with a download link. That phase is designed and specified before it is planned.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
